MD998334: Oil Seal Installer
ASSEMBLY SERVICE POINTS
>>A<< OIL SEAL INSTALLATION
1. Apply a small amount of ATF to the lip of oil seal.
2. Use special tool MD998334 to tap the oil seal in the oil pump 
body.
>>B<< O-RING INSTALLATION
Install a new O-ring to the outer groove of the oil pump, and 
apply ATF or petroleum jelly (Vaseline) to the O-ring.
